dhl-group.name: DHL Group
dhl-group.description: DHL Group is a German multinational package delivery and supply chain management company headquartered in Bonn, Germany. It is one of the world's largest courier companies and includes the postal division Deutsche Post, which is Europe's largest postal company.

dxc-technology.name: DXC Technology
dxc-technology.description: DXC Technology Company is an American multinational information technology services and consulting company headquartered in Ashburn, Virginia. It operates in the quaternary sector of the economy providing IT solutions globally.

dollar-tree.name: Dollar Tree
dollar-tree.description: Dollar Tree, Inc. is an American discount variety store chain headquartered in Chesapeake, Virginia. It operates over 9,000 stores across the contiguous U.S. and Canada, supported by a nationwide logistics network of 24 distribution centers.

deutsche-bank.name: Deutsche Bank
deutsche-bank.description: Deutsche Bank AG is a German multinational banking institution headquartered in Frankfurt. It is dual-listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange and the New York Stock Exchange. The bank provides a wide range of financial services globally.

dupont.name: DuPont
dupont.description: DuPont de Nemours, Inc. is a Delaware-headquartered company producing products for healthcare, water, construction, and industrial markets. Founded in 1802 by Éleuthère Irénée du Pont de Nemours, it has a long history in chemical production and innovation.

delivery-hero.name: Delivery Hero
delivery-hero.description: Delivery Hero SE is a German multinational online food ordering and delivery company headquartered in Berlin. Founded in 2011, it operates in over 60 countries and has expanded into quick commerce for rapid delivery of small orders and groceries.

d-ieteren-group.name: D'Ieteren Group
d-ieteren-group.description: D'Ieteren Group SA/NV is a Belgian company engaged in automobile distribution and vehicle glass repair and replacement. It also conducts other industrial activities related to spare parts. The company is based in Belgium.

dia.name: Dia
dia.description: Distribuidora Internacional de Alimentación, S.A. (DIA) is a Spanish multinational discount supermarket chain founded in 1979.

dai-nippon-printing.name: Dai Nippon Printing
dai-nippon-printing.description: Dai Nippon Printing is a Japanese printing company established in 1876. It operates in three main areas: information communications, lifestyle and industrial supplies, and electronics. The company is based in Japan.

dole-plc.name: Dole plc
dole-plc.description: Dole plc is an Irish agricultural multinational corporation headquartered in Dublin. It is one of the world's largest producers of fruit and vegetables, operating in 75 countries with 38,500 employees. The company supplies around 300 products globally.

dbs-bank.name: DBS Bank
dbs-bank.description: DBS Bank Limited is a Singaporean multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered at the Marina Bay Financial Centre in Singapore. It was formerly known as The Development Bank of Singapore Limited before adopting the abbreviated name DBS in 2003. DBS is one of the "Big Three" local banks in Singapore.

dutch-bros-coffee.name: Dutch Bros. Coffee
dutch-bros-coffee.description: Dutch Bros Inc. is a publicly held drive-through coffee chain in the United States, founded in 1992. It is headquartered in Tempe, Arizona, having previously been based in Grants Pass, Oregon. The company operates company-owned and franchise locations primarily in the Western United States and has expanded as far east as Orlando, Florida.

demant-a-s.name: Demant A/S
demant-a-s.description: Demant A/S is a Danish international company specializing in hearing care, hearing aids, and audiometric equipment. It is headquartered in Smørum, Denmark.

dic-corporation.name: DIC Corporation
dic-corporation.description: DIC Corporation is a Japanese chemical company that develops, manufactures, and sells inks, pigments, polymers, specialty plastics, compounds, and biochemicals.

dfds.name: DFDS
dfds.description: DFDS is a Danish international shipping and logistics company founded in 1866 by merging the three biggest Danish steamship companies of that time. The company's name is an abbreviation of Det Forenede Dampskibs-Selskab.

dahua-technology.name: Dahua Technology
dahua-technology.description: Zhejiang Dahua Technology Co., Ltd. is a publicly traded company based in Hangzhou, China, that manufactures video surveillance equipment. A minority of the company is state-owned.

dassault-aviation.name: Dassault Aviation
dassault-aviation.description: Dassault Aviation SA is a French manufacturer of military aircraft and business jets. Founded in 1929 by Marcel Bloch, the company was renamed Avions Marcel Dassault in 1947 after its founder changed his name to Marcel Dassault. It is based in France and has a long history in the arms industry.

discovery-inc.name: Discovery, Inc.
discovery-inc.description: Discovery, Inc. was an American multinational mass media and factual television conglomerate based in New York City, operating from 1982 to 2022. It owned channels like Discovery Channel and Animal Planet and acquired Scripps Networks Interactive in 2018.

dixon-technologies.name: Dixon Technologies
dixon-technologies.description: Dixon Technologies is an Indian multinational electronics manufacturing services company based in Noida, Uttar Pradesh. It manufactures consumer electronics like televisions and smartphones for major brands and operates 17 manufacturing units in India.

danieli.name: Danieli
danieli.description: Danieli Group is an Italian supplier of equipment and physical plants to the metal industry. Based in Buttrio, Italy, it is a world leader in the production of steel plants, especially in the long products segment.

detskiy-mir.name: Detskiy Mir
detskiy-mir.description: Detsky Mir, or Children's World, is a Russian children's goods retailer founded in 1957. It operates 1125 stores across Russia, Belarus, and Kazakhstan, making it the largest children's retailer in Russia and the CIS. The company went public in 2017 and is considered systemically important in Russia.

dniprospetsstal.name: DNIPROSPETSSTAL
dniprospetsstal.description: Dneprospetsstal (DSS) is a Ukrainian manufacturer of special stainless steel based in Zaporizhia. Founded in 1932 as a state-run enterprise, it is now a publicly traded company known as JPrSC Electrometallurgical Works Dneprospetsstal named after A. N. Kuzmin.

dowa-holdings.name: Dowa Holdings
dowa-holdings.description: Dowa Holdings is a Japanese nonferrous metals manufacturer. The company is a component of the Nikkei 225 stock index.

deutsche-borse.name: Deutsche Börse
deutsche-borse.description: Deutsche Börse AG is a German multinational corporation headquartered in Frankfurt that operates a marketplace for trading shares and securities. Founded in 1992, it provides transaction services and access to global capital markets. It is the third-largest stock market in Europe by market capitalization.

dongfeng-automobile-company-limited.name: Dongfeng Automobile Company Limited
dongfeng-automobile-company-limited.description: Dongfeng Automobile Co., Ltd. is a Chinese automobile company based in Xiangyang, Hubei. It is a subsidiary of Dongfeng Motor Co., Ltd., a joint venture between Dongfeng Motor Group and Nissan, with Dongfeng Motor Corporation as the majority owner.

devon-energy.name: Devon Energy
devon-energy.description: Devon Energy Corporation is an American hydrocarbon exploration company headquartered in Houston, Texas, and organized in Delaware. Its operations focus on regions including the Delaware Basin, Eagle Ford Group, and the Rocky Mountains.

despegar.name: Despegar
despegar.description: Despegar.com Corp. is an online travel company based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. Founded in 1999, it operates a booking platform for airline tickets, hotels, package tours, and other travel products in Latin America.

de-la-rue.name: De La Rue
de-la-rue.description: De La Rue plc is a British company headquartered in Basingstoke, England. It produces secure digital and physical protections for goods, trade, and identities, selling to governments, central banks, and businesses in 140 countries.

dan-hotels-ltd.name: Dan Hotels  Ltd.
dan-hotels-ltd.description: Dan Hotels is an Israeli hotel chain established in 1947. It owns 18 hotels in Israel, a convention center, a hotel training center, and a 226-room hotel in Bangalore, India.

dermapharm.name: Dermapharm
dermapharm.description: Dermapharm Holding SE is a publicly listed German pharmaceutical company based in Grünwald. It specializes in manufacturing and distributing dermatological and allergological preparations.

dynegy.name: Dynegy
dynegy.description: Dynegy Inc. is an electric company based in Houston, Texas, owning and operating fossil fuel-powered power stations in the U.S. Founded in 1984 as Natural Gas Clearinghouse, it was acquired by Vistra Corp in 2018.

dolby.name: Dolby
dolby.description: Dolby Laboratories, Inc. is an American technology corporation specializing in audio noise reduction, audio encoding/compression, spatial audio, and HDR imaging. It licenses its technologies to consumer electronics manufacturers and is known for the Dolby Digital audio encoding format.

dolphin-drilling.name: Dolphin Drilling
dolphin-drilling.description: Dolphin Drilling Holdings Limited is an offshore drilling rig company headquartered in Aberdeen, Scotland, with its main subsidiary in Sandnes, Norway. The company previously had its headquarters in Oslo until 2019.

digitalglobe.name: DigitalGlobe
digitalglobe.description: DigitalGlobe was an American commercial vendor of space imagery and geospatial content, operating civilian remote sensing spacecraft. It went public in 2009 and was acquired by Maxar Technologies in 2017.

dunkin-brands.name: Dunkin' Brands
dunkin-brands.description: Dunkin' Brands Group, Inc. was an American restaurant holding company headquartered in Canton, Massachusetts. It operated Dunkin' Donuts, Mister Donut, and Baskin-Robbins before being acquired by Inspire Brands in 2020.

dfi-inc.name: DFI Inc.
dfi-inc.description: DFI is a Taiwanese industrial computer company headquartered in Taipei. It designs, develops, manufactures, and sells industrial motherboards, PCs, System-on-Module, industrial displays, and provides ODM/OEM services. The company operates in the computer hardware industry.

dont-nod.name: Don’t Nod
dont-nod.description: Don't Nod Entertainment SA is a French video game developer and publisher headquartered in Paris. Founded in 2008, it developed games such as Remember Me and Life Is Strange, the latter boosting its industry status. The company began third-party publishing in 2022.

delticom.name: Delticom
delticom.description: Delticom AG is a listed company headquartered in Hanover, Germany. It operates 140 online shops across 42 countries selling car and motorcycle tyres and accessories to private and corporate customers. Delticom is Europe's largest online tyre retailer.

digimarc.name: Digimarc
digimarc.description: Digimarc Corporation is a provider of enterprise software and services based in the United States. Its software includes digital identifiers designed to address counterfeiting, product authenticity, recycling accuracy, and supply chain traceability across multiple industries such as apparel, consumer packaged goods, health and beauty, and automotive.

devolver-digital.name: Devolver Digital
devolver-digital.description: Devolver Digital, Inc. is an American video game publisher based in Austin, Texas, specializing in indie games. Founded in 2009 by five executives from previous game companies, it focuses on digital distribution platforms to publish games. The company operates in the film industry sector.

daugavpils-locomotive-repair-plant.name: Daugavpils Locomotive Repair Plant
daugavpils-locomotive-repair-plant.description: Daugavpils Locomotive Repair Plant is a Latvian railway rolling stock repair and metalworking company based in Daugavpils. Its origins trace back to steam-locomotive repair workshops established in 1866. The current joint-stock company was registered in Latvia in 1991.

delek-us.name: Delek US
delek-us.description: Delek US Holdings, Inc. is an oil refining, logistics, and biofuels company founded in 2001. It is headquartered in Brentwood, Tennessee. The company operates in the petroleum industry.

dl-e-c.name: DL E&C
dl-e-c.description: DL E&C Co., Ltd. is a construction company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. It was formerly the construction division of Daelim Industrial.

definium-therapeutics.name: Definium Therapeutics
definium-therapeutics.description: Definium Therapeutics, Inc., formerly MindMed, is a New York-based biotechnology company developing clinical and therapeutic applications for psychedelic and psychoplastogenic drugs.

dipped-products.name: Dipped Products
dipped-products.description: Dipped Products PLC is a Sri Lankan rubber glove manufacturer that also manages rubber and tea plantations. Incorporated in 1976 and listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange since 1983, it is controlled by the Hayleys conglomerate and is part of the S&P Sri Lanka 20 Index.

damai-entertainment.name: Damai Entertainment
damai-entertainment.description: Damai Entertainment Holdings Limited is a Chinese film company under Alibaba Group. Formerly known as ChinaVision Media and later Alibaba Pictures Group, it was renamed Damai Entertainment Holdings in June 2025. By 2015, it was the largest Chinese film company by market value.

dhani.name: Dhani
dhani.description: Dhani is an Indian software company that provides digital financial and healthcare services through its app. It operates in the technology sector, combining software solutions with healthcare and finance.

dongfeng-motor-group-company-limited.name: Dongfeng Motor Group Company Limited
dongfeng-motor-group-company-limited.description: Dongfeng Motor Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese holding company based in Wuhan, Hubei. It is involved in the automotive industry and has H shares listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange.

digitalbridge.name: DigitalBridge
digitalbridge.description: DigitalBridge Group, Inc. is a global digital infrastructure investment firm headquartered in Boca Raton, USA. It owns and operates assets like cell towers, data centers, and fiber networks, with offices worldwide.

dusit-international.name: Dusit International
dusit-international.description: Dusit Thani Public Company Limited, branded as Dusit International, is a Thai multinational hospitality company headquartered in Bangkok. It operates 57 hotels and resorts and approximately 240 villas across 18 countries. The company was founded in 1948 by Thanpuying Chanut Piyaoui.

daicel.name: Daicel
daicel.description: Daicel Corporation is a Japanese chemical company operating in celluloid technologies, organic chemicals, high-performance chemicals, polymers, and pyrotechnic devices. Its products include cellulose acetate, cigarette filter tow, engineering plastics, and automotive airbag inflators.

dynic-corporation.name: Dynic Corporation
dynic-corporation.description: Dynic Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer of print media supplies, publishing products, stationery, non-woven fabrics, embossed products, foils, films, and paper products. The company is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and based in Japan.

dena.name: DeNA
dena.description: DeNA Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company headquartered in Shibuya, Tokyo, that provides mobile portal and e-commerce websites. It owns the Mobage cell phone platform and operates other services including the e-commerce website DeNA Shopping.

daito-trust-construction.name: Daito Trust Construction
daito-trust-construction.description: The Daito Trust Construction Company, Ltd. is a Japanese construction and real estate company based in Minato-ku, Tokyo. It is listed on the Tokyo and Nagoya Stock Exchanges and is part of the TOPIX Large70 stock index.

drb-hicom.name: DRB-HICOM
drb-hicom.description: DRB-HICOM Berhad is a Malaysian automotive company involved in manufacturing, assembly, and distribution. It is the majority shareholder of Proton and owns Modenas, assembling cars for multiple international brands.

daiwa-securities-group.name: Daiwa Securities Group
daiwa-securities-group.description: Daiwa Securities Group Inc. is a Japanese investment bank and the second largest securities brokerage in Japan after Nomura Securities.

daktronics.name: Daktronics
daktronics.description: Daktronics, Inc. is an American company based in Brookings, South Dakota, that designs and manufactures video displays, scoreboards, and related products. It was founded in 1968 by two South Dakota State University professors.

danaher-corporation.name: Danaher Corporation
danaher-corporation.description: Danaher Corporation is an American healthcare company headquartered in Washington, D.C. It develops products for biotechnology, life sciences, and diagnostics and operates three divisions focused on therapeutics, disease identification, and diagnostics.

dassault-systemes-france.name: Dassault Systèmes
dassault-systemes-france.description: Dassault Systèmes SE is a French multinational software corporation that develops software for 3D product design, simulation, manufacturing, and other 3D related products. The company is based in France and operates in the digital distribution sector.

debenhams-plc.name: Debenhams PLC
debenhams-plc.description: Debenhams plc was a British department store chain operating in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Denmark, and franchised locations across Europe and the Asia Pacific. The company was based in the United Kingdom and operated in the retail sector.

deckers-outdoor-corporation.name: Deckers Outdoor Corporation
deckers-outdoor-corporation.description: Deckers Outdoor Corporation, also known as Deckers Brands, is an American footwear designer and distributor founded in 1973 and based in Goleta, California. Its portfolio includes brands such as UGG, Teva, and Hoka. The company was founded by Doug Otto and Karl F. Lopker.

del-taco.name: Del Taco
del-taco.description: Del Taco Restaurants, Inc. is an American fast food chain headquartered in Lake Forest, California. It offers tacos, burritos, fries, and burgers and operates approximately 595 locations across 18 US states.

delek-group-ltd.name: Delek Group Ltd.
delek-group-ltd.description: Delek Group is an Israeli holding conglomerate mainly operating in the petroleum industry. It owns Delek – The Israel Fuel Corporation, a large filling station chain, and has exploration and production operations in the Levant, North Sea, and Gulf of Mexico. It also owns a coffeehouse chain and a majority stake in the Israeli Burger King franchise.

don-quijote.name: Don Quijote
don-quijote.description: Don Quijote Co., Ltd., known as Donki, is a Japanese discount store chain. It offers a wide range of products from groceries to electronics and clothing, often staying open late or 24/7 with densely packed merchandise.

denny-s.name: Denny's
denny-s.description: Denny's is an American diner-style restaurant chain operating over 1,400 locations across the United States, Canada, Mexico, Puerto Rico, and other countries. It is known for its table service dining experience.

dentsu.name: Dentsu
dentsu.description: Dentsu Group Inc. is a Japanese international advertising and public relations company headquartered in Tokyo. It is the largest advertising agency in Japan and ranks fifth worldwide by revenue.

dish.name: Dish
dish.description: DISH Network LLC, known as Dish, is an American provider of satellite television and IPTV services. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of EchoStar Corporation and competes primarily with DirecTV.

drdgold-limited.name: DRDGOLD Limited
drdgold-limited.description: DRDGOLD Limited is a South African gold producer specializing in recovering gold from the retreatment of surface tailings. The company is publicly traded on both the New York and Johannesburg stock exchanges.

diebold-nixdorf.name: Diebold Nixdorf
diebold-nixdorf.description: Diebold Nixdorf, Incorporated is an American multinational company based in North Canton, Ohio. It specializes in financial and retail technology, including self-service transaction systems, point-of-sale terminals, and security products, serving global financial, retail, and commercial markets.

dollar-thrifty-automotive-group.name: Dollar Thrifty Automotive Group
dollar-thrifty-automotive-group.description: Dollar Thrifty Automotive Group was the holding company for Thrifty Car Rental and Dollar Rent A Car. It operated as a subsidiary of Chrysler Corporation starting in 1997 and was acquired by The Hertz Corporation in 2012.

dr-pepper-snapple-group.name: Dr Pepper Snapple Group
dr-pepper-snapple-group.description: Dr Pepper Snapple Group was an American multinational soft drink company based in Plano, Texas. It originated as Cadbury Schweppes Americas Beverages, a division of Cadbury Schweppes. The company operated in the beverage industry.

drax-group.name: Drax Group
drax-group.description: Drax Group plc is a renewable energy company based in the United Kingdom. It operates biomass-fueled power stations and pellet production plants across North America. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

dear-u.name: Dear U
dear-u.description: Dear U is a South Korean software development company established in July 2017, formerly known as Everysing. It merged with Brinicle and specializes in multimedia content hosting and artist-to-fan communications, offering products like Everysing, Lysn, and Bubble.

dollar-general.name: Dollar General
dollar-general.description: Dollar General Corporation is an American discount store chain headquartered in Goodlettsville, Tennessee. It operates thousands of stores across the contiguous United States and Mexico. The company focuses on retailing a variety of consumer goods.

delhaize-le-lion.name: Delhaize Le Lion
delhaize-le-lion.description: Delhaize Group SA was a Belgian multinational retail company headquartered in Brussels, operating food supermarkets in seven countries across three continents. In 2015, it merged with Ahold to form Ahold Delhaize.

dexcom.name: Dexcom
dexcom.description: Dexcom, Inc. is an American multinational healthcare company that develops and manufactures continuous glucose monitoring systems for diabetes management. It is headquartered in San Diego, California, with manufacturing facilities in the US, Malaysia, and Ireland.

dali-foods-group.name: Dali Foods Group
dali-foods-group.description: Dali Foods Group is a baked goods company headquartered in Hui'an County, Quanzhou, Fujian, China. It operates in the food industry within China.

datadog.name: Datadog
datadog.description: Datadog, Inc. is an American company headquartered in New York City that provides an observability service for cloud-scale applications. It offers monitoring of servers, databases, tools, and services through a SaaS-based data analytics platform. The company is publicly traded on the Nasdaq stock exchange.

dmg-mori-seiki.name: DMG Mori Seiki
dmg-mori-seiki.description: DMG Mori Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company headquartered in Tokyo and Nara City. It primarily manufactures and sells machine tools and has become the largest machine tool builder in the world.

dragonwave.name: DragonWave
dragonwave.description: DragonWave-X is a multinational corporation headquartered in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada. It supplies packet microwave radio systems for mobile and access IP networks globally. The company operates in the telecom sector.

dover-corporation.name: Dover Corporation
dover-corporation.description: Dover Corporation is an American conglomerate manufacturer of industrial products based in Downers Grove, Illinois. It is listed on the New York Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the S&P 500 index. Dover operates in the mechanical engineering industry.

digitalocean.name: DigitalOcean
digitalocean.description: DigitalOcean Holdings, Inc. is an American multinational technology company and cloud service provider headquartered in Broomfield, Colorado. It offers cloud infrastructure-as-a-service platforms to developers, startups, and SMBs with 15 globally distributed data centers.

dutch-lady-milk-industries-berhad.name: Dutch Lady Milk Industries Berhad
dutch-lady-milk-industries-berhad.description: Dutch Lady Milk Industries Berhad manufactures cow milk and dairy products in Malaysia and several Asian countries. It was formerly part of Royal FrieslandFoods and is now a subsidiary of FrieslandCampina. The company has been operating since the 1960s.

danya-group.name: Danya Group
danya-group.description: Danya Cebus is an Israeli construction company founded in 1997 and a subsidiary of Africa Israel Investments. It operates in Israel, Russia, and Romania.

dwf-llp.name: DWF LLP
dwf-llp.description: DWF LLP is an international law firm headquartered in Manchester, England. It operates 35 offices worldwide, providing legal services across multiple regions.

dhanlaxmi-bank.name: Dhanlaxmi Bank
dhanlaxmi-bank.description: Dhanlaxmi Bank is an Indian private sector bank headquartered in Thrissur, Kerala. Incorporated on 14 November 1927, it became a Scheduled Commercial Bank in 1977.

doordash.name: DoorDash
doordash.description: DoorDash, Inc. is an American company operating online food ordering and delivery services. It holds a 56% market share in the US food delivery market and a 60% share in convenience delivery. The platform serves merchants, consumers, and delivery couriers across the United States.

del-frisco-s-restaurant-group.name: Del Frisco's Restaurant Group
del-frisco-s-restaurant-group.description: Del Frisco's Restaurant Group, Inc. was an American steakhouse restaurant chain founded in 1981. It operated Del Frisco's Grille and Del Frisco's Double Eagle Steak House in the United States. The company became public in 2012 and focused on steakhouse dining.

denbury-resources.name: Denbury Resources
denbury-resources.description: Denbury Inc. was a company engaged in hydrocarbon exploration and extraction using enhanced oil recovery with carbon dioxide. It focused on extracting petroleum from previously exploited fields. In November 2023, it was acquired by ExxonMobil.

dawonsys.name: Dawonsys
dawonsys.industry: Installation of mechanical machines and equipment
dawonsys.description: Dawonsys is a South Korean company manufacturing rolling stock, display, semiconductor, plant equipment, and environmental systems. It adopted its current name in May 2001 to reflect its parent company.

deliveroo.name: Deliveroo
deliveroo.description: Roofoods Ltd, trading as Deliveroo, is a British multinational online food delivery company based in London. It was acquired by DoorDash in October 2025 and worked with around 182,000 restaurants, grocers, and retailers as of August the previous year.

dongxing-securities.name: Dongxing Securities
dongxing-securities.description: Dongxing Securities Co., Ltd. is a Chinese investment bank and brokerage firm. It was a constituent of the SSE 50 Index and CSI 100 Index.

deme.name: DEME
deme.description: DEME is an international group based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, specializing in dredging, land reclamation, port infrastructure, offshore oil & gas services, offshore windfarm installation, and environmental remediation with operations on five continents.

dexus.name: Dexus
dexus.description: Dexus is an Australasian real assets manager and owner founded in 1984. The company is publicly listed on the Australian Securities Exchange and operates in the real estate sector.

dentsply-sirona.name: Dentsply Sirona
dentsply-sirona.description: Dentsply Sirona Inc. is an American manufacturer of dental equipment and consumables, marketing products in over 120 countries. The company was formed largely from a 1993 merger involving Gendex Corporation and Dentsply International Inc.

dallasnews-corporation.name: DallasNews Corporation
dallasnews-corporation.description: DallasNews Corporation, formerly A. H. Belo Corporation, was a Dallas, Texas-based media holding company of The Dallas Morning News and Belo + Company. In 2025, it was purchased by Hearst Communications and remains a formal subsidiary.

diplomat-pharmacy.name: Diplomat Pharmacy
diplomat-pharmacy.description: Diplomat Pharmacy, Inc. was the largest independent provider of specialty pharmacy services in the United States. Headquartered in Flint, Michigan, it offers specialized medication and management programs for patients with complex conditions and operates facilities across the US.

dynatrace.name: Dynatrace
dynatrace.description: Dynatrace, Inc. is an American multinational technology company providing an AI-powered observability platform. Its software monitors and optimizes application performance, software development, cybersecurity, IT infrastructure, and user experience.

dabur.name: Dabur
dabur.description: Dabur India Limited is an Indian multinational consumer goods company headquartered in Ghaziabad, Delhi NCR. Founded in 1884, it manufactures Ayurvedic products and fast-moving consumer goods, with revenue from consumer care, food, and international business units.

dhc-software-co-ltd.name: DHC Software Co., Ltd.
dhc-software-co-ltd.description: DHC Software Co., Ltd. is a publicly traded company based in Beijing, China. It has been a constituent of the SZSE 100 Index, SZSE 300 Index, and SZSE Component Index.

descartes-systems-group.name: Descartes Systems Group
descartes-systems-group.description: The Descartes Systems Group Inc. is a Canadian multinational technology company specializing in logistics and supply chain management software. It provides cloud-based services tailored for logistics businesses.

dubber.name: Dubber
dubber.description: Dubber is an Australian cloud-based call recording software company founded in Melbourne in 2011. It operates as a software-as-a-service and voice data provider, primarily selling to telecommunications service providers and enterprise customers.

datang-international-power-generation-co.name: Datang International Power Generation Co., Ltd.
datang-international-power-generation-co.legal_name: Datang International Power Generation Co., Ltd.
datang-international-power-generation-co.description: Datang International Power Generation Company Limited is one of the five largest state-owned power producers in China, particularly in Northern China. It develops and operates power plants, sells electricity and thermal power, and provides repair and maintenance services for power equipment.

listings.name: Datang International Power Generation Co., Ltd.

discount-investment-corp-ltd.name: Discount Investment Corp. Ltd.
discount-investment-corp-ltd.description: Discount Investment Corporation Ltd. is a holding company based in Israel. It is listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange and controlled by IDB Development Company, which is held by IDB Holding Corporation Ltd.

delta-galil-industries-ltd.name: Delta Galil Industries Ltd.
delta-galil-industries-ltd.description: Delta Galil Industries is a global designer, manufacturer, and marketer of branded and private label apparel products for men, women, and children. The company operates in the textile industry and is based in Israel.

datang-telecom-technology.name: Datang Telecom Technology
datang-telecom-technology.description: Datang Telecom Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese state-owned telecommunications company based in Beijing. Established in 1998, it was the first Chinese state research institute restructured into a publicly listed company and was once grouped among China's major telecom vendors.

dlf-limited.name: DLF Limited
dlf-limited.description: DLF Limited is an Indian commercial real estate development company founded in 1946 and based in Gurugram, Haryana. It has developed several residential colonies in Delhi and builds residential, office, and retail properties.

davidstea.name: DavidsTea
davidstea.description: DavidsTea is a Canadian specialty tea and tea accessory retailer headquartered in Montreal, Quebec. It is the largest Canadian-based specialty tea boutique in the country and operates in the consumer goods and retail industry.

d-link.name: D-Link
d-link.description: D-Link Systems, Inc. is a Taiwanese multinational manufacturer of networking hardware and telecommunications equipment. Founded in 1986, it is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, and serves global markets with its products.

dexco.name: Dexco
dexco.description: Dexco, formerly Duratex, is a Brazilian company producing fiberboards and wood panels. It operates in Brazil and Colombia and is controlled by the Itaúsa and Ligna Groups. Dexco is the eighth largest wood panel producer globally and the largest in the Southern Hemisphere.

daifuku.name: Daifuku
daifuku.description: Daifuku Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company founded in 1937 that manufactures material-handling equipment. It is headquartered in Osaka, Japan. The company operates in the machinery and equipment manufacturing sector.

den-networks.name: DEN Networks
den-networks.description: DEN Networks Limited is an Indian cable television and broadband service provider. It was acquired by Reliance Industries in 2018 and was one of the three major cable distributors in India in 2003.

danamon-of-indonesia.name: Danamon of Indonesia
danamon-of-indonesia.description: PT Bank Danamon Indonesia Tbk is an Indonesian bank established in 1956. It is the sixth largest bank in Indonesia by asset size.

doosan-group.name: Doosan Group
doosan-group.description: Doosan Group is a South Korean multinational conglomerate and the oldest running company in South Korea. It is the parent company of Bobcat and Škoda Power and was ranked among the world's top 10 largest heavy equipment manufacturers in 2018.

duke-realty.name: Duke Realty
duke-realty.description: Duke Realty was a real estate investment trust based in Indianapolis, Indiana, focusing on industrial properties. As of late 2021, it owned or controlled 548 industrial properties. In October 2022, it was acquired by Prologis.

desktop-metal.name: Desktop Metal
desktop-metal.description: Desktop Metal, Inc. is an American technology company headquartered in Burlington, Massachusetts. It designs and markets 3D printing systems and was named a Technology Pioneer by the World Economic Forum in 2017.

delphi-technologies.name: Delphi Technologies
delphi-technologies.description: Delphi Technologies was an independent automotive company in the United States from 2017 until its acquisition by BorgWarner Inc. in 2020. In 2023, BorgWarner spun off Delphi Technologies along with Delco Remy and Hartridge into a separate publicly traded company named PHINIA.

doosan-enerbility.name: Doosan Enerbility
doosan-enerbility.description: Doosan Enerbility Co., Ltd., formerly Doosan Heavy Industries, is a heavy industrial company headquartered in Changwon, South Korea. It operates in the heavy industry sector.

decode-genetics.name: deCODE genetics
decode-genetics.description: deCODE genetics is a biopharmaceutical company based in Reykjavík, Iceland, founded in 1996 by Kári Stefánsson. It focuses on population-level genetics studies to identify genome variations linked to common diseases for treatment and prevention.

dreamworks-animation.name: DreamWorks Animation
dreamworks-animation.description: DreamWorks Animation L.L.C. is an American animation studio owned by Comcast's NBCUniversal. It has produced 54 feature films since its first release in 1998 and is part of Universal Filmed Entertainment Group.

destination-xl-group.name: Destination XL Group
destination-xl-group.description: Destination XL Group, Inc. is a retailer specializing in Men's Big and Tall apparel with 290 retail and outlet stores in the United States. Headquartered in Canton, Massachusetts, it also operates an e-commerce website and mobile apps serving multiple global markets.

dayforce-inc.name: Dayforce, Inc.
dayforce-inc.description: Dayforce, Inc., formerly Ceridian, is an American human resources software and services company. It operates in the AI and software industry, providing solutions related to human resources management.

d-r-horton.name: D. R. Horton
d-r-horton.description: D.R. Horton, Inc. is an American home construction company based in Arlington, Texas. Since 2002, it has been the largest homebuilder by volume in the United States, operating in 125 markets across 36 states.

dasa-s-a.name: DASA S.A.
dasa-s-a.description: Diagnósticos da América S.A. (DASA) is a Brazil-based clinical diagnostics company. It also operates units in food testing, advertising, publishing, human resources services, and research.

dbv-technologies.name: DBV Technologies
dbv-technologies.description: DBV Technologies SA is a publicly owned French biopharmaceutical firm headquartered in Bagneux, France. It is known for developing Viaskin technology for allergen administration to intact skin, with its Viaskin Peanut clinical development receiving Fast Track designation from the US FDA.

dcc-energy-plc.name: DCC Energy plc
dcc-energy-plc.description: DCC Energy plc is a multi-energy sales and distribution business operating in Europe and the United States. It focuses on energy sales and distribution across these regions.

dfcc-bank.name: DFCC Bank
dfcc-bank.description: DFCC Bank is a development finance institution established in 1955 in Sri Lanka on the recommendation of the World Bank. It is one of the oldest development banks in Asia.

dle.name: DLE
dle.description: DLE Inc. is a Tokyo-based animation and entertainment company founded in 2001 by former Sony executive producer Ryuta Shiiki. It is known for the animated series Eagle Talon and has partnerships across Asia and North America.

dst-systems.name: DST Systems
dst-systems.description: DST Systems, Inc. was an American company providing advisory, technology, and operations outsourcing services to financial services and healthcare industries. Founded in 1969, it was headquartered in Kansas City, Missouri, and acquired by SS&C Technologies in 2018.

designer-brands.name: Designer Brands
designer-brands.description: Designer Brands Inc. is an American retailer selling designer and name brand shoes and fashion accessories. It owns the Designer Shoe Warehouse (DSW) chain with over 500 stores in the United States and operates an e-commerce website.

ds-smith.name: DS Smith
ds-smith.description: DS Smith plc is a British multinational packaging business headquartered in London. It was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by International Paper in January 2025.

dte-energy.name: DTE Energy
dte-energy.description: DTE Energy is an American diversified energy company operating in the United States and Canada. Its units include an electric utility serving 2.2 million customers and a natural gas utility serving 1.3 million customers in Michigan.

davita.name: DaVita
davita.description: DaVita Inc. is an American health care company headquartered in Denver, Delaware. It provides kidney dialysis services through a network of outpatient centers in the United States and other countries. The company primarily treats end-stage renal disease requiring regular dialysis or kidney transplants.

dah-chong-hong.name: Dah Chong Hong
dah-chong-hong.description: Dah Chong Hong Holdings Limited is a Hong Kong–based conglomerate engaged in motor vehicle sales and repair, air cargo equipment distribution, cosmetics, airport ground support equipment maintenance, food, logistics, and warehouse services.

dah-sing-bank-limited.name: Dah Sing Bank Limited
dah-sing-bank-limited.description: Dah Sing Banking Group Limited is a Hong Kong–based banking and financial company headquartered in Wan Chai. It operates through three main banking subsidiaries with a branch network across Hong Kong, Macau, and mainland China, and includes a securities trading company.

daily-journal-corporation.name: Daily Journal Corporation
daily-journal-corporation.description: Daily Journal Corporation is an American publishing and technology company headquartered in Los Angeles, California. It has offices in multiple U.S. cities and Melbourne, Australia. Under Charles T. Munger's leadership, its newspapers focus on reporting about the U.S. legal system.

dalian-port-pda-company.name: Dalian Port (PDA) Company
dalian-port-pda-company.description: Liaoning Port Co., Ltd. operates the Port of Dalian in Liaoning, China. It provides container loading and discharging, storage for crude and refined oils and chemicals, container logistics, and operates container depots, warehouses, shipping agencies, cargo forwarders, and a bonded logistics park.

dana-corporation.name: Dana Corporation
dana-corporation.description: Dana Incorporated is an American supplier of axles, driveshafts, and various equipment for conventional, hybrid, and electric vehicles. Founded in 1904 and based in Maumee, Ohio, it serves light and commercial vehicle markets and operates in 33 countries.

dashang-group.name: Dashang Group
dashang-group.description: Dashang Group is a retail company headquartered in Dalian, Liaoning Province, China. It operates department stores, supermarkets, and other retail businesses and is the largest retailer in Northeast China.

data-i-o.name: Data I/O
data-i-o.description: Data I/O Corporation provides manual and automated data programming and security provisioning systems for flash memory and other devices. Founded in 1969, it has developed equipment used in industries such as IoT, medical development, and consumer electronics.

dataram.name: Dataram
dataram.description: Dataram is a manufacturer of computer memory and software products headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey. Founded in 1967, it provides memory, storage, and services worldwide to OEMs, distributors, and enterprise customers.

datong-coal-industry.name: Datong Coal Industry
datong-coal-industry.description: Datong Coal Industry Co., Ltd., established in 2001 and headquartered in Datong City, China, is engaged in excavating, processing, and sales of coal. It is a subsidiary of Datong Coal Mining Group and operates in Shanxi Province, known for having the greatest coal deposits in China.

dave-buster-s.name: Dave & Buster's
dave-buster-s.description: Dave & Buster's Entertainment, Inc. is an American restaurant and entertainment business headquartered in Dallas, Texas. Founded in 1982, it combines a full-service restaurant, bar, and video arcade known as the "Million Dollar Midway". The company operates locations across the United States, Puerto Rico, Canada, and several international franchises.

delta-djakarta.name: Delta Djakarta
delta-djakarta.description: PT Delta Djakarta is a brewing company founded in 1932 and headquartered in Bekasi, Indonesia. Its main brand is Anker, a pale lager, and it is partially owned by San Miguel Malaysia and the government of Jakarta.

deluxe-corporation.name: Deluxe Corporation
deluxe-corporation.description: Deluxe Corporation is an American financial services company providing payment processing, data services, checks, promotional products, and merchant services. It operates in four divisions and serves millions of small businesses and thousands of financial institutions.

dendreon.name: Dendreon
dendreon.description: Dendreon Pharmaceuticals LLC is a biotechnology company known for its immunotherapy product Provenge for prostate cancer. Provenge uses a mixture of the patient's blood cells incubated with a fusion protein and received FDA approval in 2010 after successful Phase III trials.

destination-maternity-corporation.name: Destination Maternity Corporation
destination-maternity-corporation.description: Destination Maternity Corporation is the world's largest designer and retailer of maternity apparel. The company is based in Moorestown, New Jersey, United States.

dcb-bank.name: DCB Bank
dcb-bank.description: DCB Bank Limited is a private sector scheduled commercial bank headquartered in Lower Parel, Mumbai, India. It traces its origins to the 1930s and received its scheduled commercial bank license from the Reserve Bank of India on May 31, 1995.

dialog.name: Dialog
dialog.description: Dialog Axiata PLC is the largest telecommunications service provider in Sri Lanka, holding nearly 67% of the mobile market share with around 19.6 million subscribers. It is a subsidiary of Axiata Group Berhad, which owns 73.75%, while Bharti Airtel owns 10.355%.

diamond-offshore-drilling.name: Diamond Offshore Drilling
diamond-offshore-drilling.description: Diamond Offshore Drilling, Inc. is an offshore drilling contractor headquartered in Katy, Texas, United States. The company has major offices in Australia, Brazil, Mexico, Scotland, Singapore, and Norway.

divi-s-laboratories.name: Divi's Laboratories
divi-s-laboratories.description: Divi's Laboratories Limited is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Hyderabad. It produces active pharmaceutical ingredients and intermediates, and also supplies nutraceutical ingredients through its subsidiary. It is India's fourth largest publicly listed pharmaceutical company by market capitalization.

digi-international.name: Digi International
digi-international.description: Digi International, Inc. is an American industrial Internet of Things technology company based in Hopkins, Minnesota. Founded in 1985, it initially manufactured multi-line serial data cards for PC clones and later shifted focus to network attached devices and industrial monitoring.

digital-china.name: Digital China
digital-china.description: Digital China is a company listed on the main board of The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong. It separated from the Legend Group in 2001.

dime-community-bank.name: Dime Community Bank
dime-community-bank.description: The Dime Commercial Bank is a local, FDIC-insured bank headquartered in Hauppauge, New York. Founded in 1864 and originally based in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, it moved its headquarters to Brooklyn Heights in 2017. In 2021, it merged with Bridge Bancorp Inc.

dine-brands-global.name: Dine Brands Global
dine-brands-global.description: Dine Brands Global, Inc. is a publicly traded food and beverage company based in Pasadena, California. Founded in 1958 as IHOP, it operates franchised and corporate owned restaurants including Applebee's, IHOP, and Fuzzy's Taco Shop.

diodes-incorporated.name: Diodes Incorporated
diodes-incorporated.description: Diodes Incorporated is a global manufacturer and supplier of application specific standard products in analog, discrete, power, logic, and mixed-signal semiconductor markets. It serves consumer electronics, computing, communications, industrial, and automotive markets.

disco-corporation.name: Disco Corporation
disco-corporation.description: DISCO Corporation is a Japanese company specializing in precision tools, particularly for the semiconductor production industry. It is based in Japan and focuses on manufacturing tools used in semiconductor fabrication.

discover-financial.name: Discover Financial
discover-financial.description: Discover Financial Services, Inc. was an American bank holding company offering consumer banking products. It owned Discover Card, Pulse, and Diners Club International. In May 2025, it was acquired by Capital One.

distilleries-company-of-sri-lanka.name: Distilleries Company of Sri Lanka
distilleries-company-of-sri-lanka.description: Distilleries Company of Sri Lanka PLC is a diversified Sri Lankan conglomerate listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange. It was among the first Sri Lankan companies included in Forbes's list of non-US Best Managed companies valued under US$1 billion and has been recognized by Business Today as a top listed company in Sri Lanka.

docusign.name: Docusign
docusign.description: Docusign, Inc. is an American software company headquartered in San Francisco, California. It provides products that help organizations manage electronic agreements and contract lifecycle processes, including electronic signatures and AI-supported data extraction across devices.

dolphin-entertainment.name: Dolphin Entertainment
dolphin-entertainment.description: Dolphin Entertainment, Inc. is an American entertainment marketing and production company based in Coral Gables, Florida. Founded in 1996, it produces television series and films primarily for children and young adults and has expanded into digital media including NFTs and influencer marketing.

domo.name: Domo
domo.description: Domo, Inc. is an American cloud software company based in American Fork, Utah. It specializes in artificial intelligence, business intelligence, and data visualization, providing real-time business data access with minimal IT involvement. The company operates as a software as a service venture.

donaldson-company.name: Donaldson Company
donaldson-company.description: Donaldson Company, Inc. is a filtration company based in the United States producing filtration products for various industries including aerospace, chemical, and pharmaceuticals. Its research division in Minneapolis has participated in defense-related military projects.

dongfang-electric.name: Dongfang Electric
dongfang-electric.description: Dongfang Electric Corporation is a Chinese state-owned manufacturer of power generators and power station project contracts. It was the second largest manufacturer of steam turbines worldwide in 2009-10 and operates the world's most powerful wind turbine at 18 MW capacity.

double-coin.name: Double Coin
double-coin.description: Double Coin is a Chinese manufacturer of radial tires for trucks headquartered in Shanghai. It is majority owned by Shanghai Huayi and produces Warrior brand tires in a joint venture with Michelin. Its North American subsidiary is China Manufacturers Alliance, LLC.

doximity.name: Doximity
doximity.description: Doximity is an online networking service for medical professionals launched in 2010. The platform provides curated medical news, telehealth tools, and case collaboration features to its members. It operates primarily in the United States.

ducommun.name: Ducommun
ducommun.description: Ducommun Incorporated is a global provider of manufacturing and engineering services. It develops electronic, engineered, and structural solutions for aerospace, defense, and industrial markets. The company is based in the United States.

dynamic-materials-corporation.name: Dynamic Materials Corporation
dynamic-materials-corporation.description: DMC Global Inc. owns and operates Arcadia, DynaEnergetics, and NobelClad, manufacturing businesses serving construction, energy, industrial processing, and transportation markets. Their products include architectural building products, engineered oil and gas perforation products, and explosion-welded clad metal plates.

dynamics-research-corporation.name: Dynamics Research Corporation
dynamics-research-corporation.description: Dynamics Research Corporation (DRC) was a publicly traded American engineering services company founded in 1955. It primarily served the U.S. Department of Defense, providing expertise in high-performance computing, cybersecurity, financial and regulatory reform, and IT modernization.

digital-domain.name: Digital Domain
digital-domain.description: Digital Domain is an American visual effects, computer animation, and digital production company headquartered in Culver City, California. It operates in the film industry providing digital production services.

dean-foods.name: Dean Foods
dean-foods.description: Dean Foods was an American food and beverage company and the largest dairy company in the United States. It produced milk, ice cream, cheese, juice, and teas under various regional and national brands. Founded in 1925, it filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in 2019 and its assets were sold in 2020.

diamondback-energy.name: Diamondback Energy
diamondback-energy.description: Diamondback Energy is an American hydrocarbon exploration company headquartered in Midland, Texas. It operates primarily in the Permian Basin. The company is part of the petroleum industry.

dfi-retail-group.name: DFI Retail Group
dfi-retail-group.description: DFI Retail Group Holdings Limited is a Hong Kong–based retail company legally based in Bermuda and Singapore. It is a major East and Southeast Asian retailer involved in food and health and beauty product processing and wholesaling, and is a subsidiary of Jardine Matheson Group.

dormakaba-holding-ag.name: dormakaba Holding AG
dormakaba-holding-ag.description: dormakaba Holding AG is a global security group based in Rümlang, Switzerland, formed from the merger of Kaba and Dorma in 2015. The company is publicly traded on the SIX Swiss Exchange.

darden-restaurants.name: Darden Restaurants
darden-restaurants.description: Darden Restaurants, Inc. is an American multi-brand restaurant operator headquartered in Orlando, Florida. It operates more than 2,100 restaurant locations and is the world's largest full-service restaurant company. The company began as an extension of Red Lobster, founded by William Darden.

draytek.name: DrayTek
draytek.description: DrayTek Corporation is a Taiwanese manufacturer of network equipment including firewalls, VPN devices, routers, managed switches, and wireless LAN devices.

domino-s-pizza.name: Domino's Pizza
domino-s-pizza.description: Domino's Pizza, Inc. is an American multinational pizza restaurant chain headquartered near Ann Arbor, Michigan. Founded in 1960, it operates thousands of stores worldwide across more than 83 countries and 5,701 cities.

dillard-s.name: Dillard's
dillard-s.description: Dillard's, Inc. is an American department store chain headquartered in Little Rock, Arkansas. Founded in 1938, it operates approximately 271 stores across 30 states, with the largest number located in Texas and Florida.

dr-reddy-s-laboratories.name: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories
dr-reddy-s-laboratories.description: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Ltd. is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company based in Hyderabad, with U.S. headquarters in East Brunswick, New Jersey. It produces pharmaceuticals, active pharmaceutical ingredients, diagnostic kits, and biotechnology products.

daiwa-house-industry.name: Daiwa House Industry
daiwa-house-industry.description: Daiwa House Industry Co., Ltd. is a Japanese multinational construction company specializing in prefabricated houses. It also constructs factories, shopping centers, healthcare facilities, and manages resort hotels and golf courses.

dresdner-bank.name: Dresdner Bank
dresdner-bank.description: Dresdner Bank AG was a German bank founded in 1872 in Dresden. It was headquartered in Berlin from 1884 to 1945 and in Frankfurt from 1963 onwards after a postwar hiatus. It was Germany's second-largest bank and was acquired by Commerzbank in May 2009.

de-beers.name: De Beers
de-beers.description: De Beers Group is a British multinational diamond company specializing in mining, trading, and marketing diamonds. It operates in 35 countries with mining activities in Botswana, Namibia, South Africa, and Canada. It also runs an artisanal mining business called Gemfair in Sierra Leone.

dogan-holding-company.name: Doğan Holding Company
dogan-holding-company.description: Doğan Holding is a Turkish holding company based in Istanbul, founded in 1959. It operates across multiple industries including electricity generation, energy, iron and steel, mining, automotive, finance, real estate, and entertainment.

dorel-industries.name: Dorel Industries
dorel-industries.description: Dorel Industries Inc. is a Canadian company based in Montreal, Quebec, designing and manufacturing juvenile products and home furnishings. It was formed in 1987 from a merger and sells products in over 100 countries.

diarios-associados.name: Diários Associados
diarios-associados.description: Diários Associados, or Associated Dailies, is a union of Brazilian communication media. It was created by Assis Chateaubriand and operates in the mass media industry in Brazil.

djezzy-gsm.name: Djezzy GSM
djezzy-gsm.description: Djezzy is one of Algeria's three main mobile network operators, covering 90% of the population. It was launched in 2002 and has been wholly owned by the Algerian state since 2022.

doosan-skoda-power.name: Doosan Škoda Power
doosan-skoda-power.description: Doosan Škoda Power is a Czech engineering company based in Plzeň that develops and manufactures steam turbines and related equipment. Its turbines are used for electricity generation and steam supply for factories and district heating, and it offers repair and maintenance services.

dno-international.name: DNO International
dno-international.description: DNO ASA is a Norwegian oil and gas operator focused on the Middle East and North Sea. Founded in 1971, it holds stakes in exploration, development, and production licenses in Iraq, Norway, the UK, and Yemen.

directv.name: DirecTV
directv.description: DirecTV, LLC is an American video programming distributor based in El Segundo, California. Launched in 1994 by Hughes, it provides virtual multichannel video programming and satellite services in the United States and Puerto Rico.

darou-pakhsh.name: Darou Pakhsh
darou-pakhsh.description: Karkhanjat Darupakhsh Company is the largest pharmaceutical company in Iran, with 74% of its shares owned by the Social Security Investment Company (Shasta).

doosan-robotics.name: Doosan Robotics
doosan-robotics.description: Doosan Robotics is a South Korean robotics company founded in 2015. It mainly manufactures collaborative robots (cobots) and ranked fifth globally in market share as of 2022.

dalia-energy-companies.name: Dalia Energy Companies
dalia-energy-companies.description: Dalia Energy Companies Ltd. is an Israeli company involved in the development, construction, and operation of electricity supply stations. It operates advanced natural gas power plants and is one of Israel's largest private electricity producers.

daycoval.name: Daycoval
daycoval.description: Banco Daycoval S.A. is a Brazilian financial institution founded in 1968 and headquartered in São Paulo. It specializes in corporate lending and retail services including payroll loans, vehicle financing, foreign exchange, and investment management. Daycoval has a national presence with 53 branches and an international branch in the Cayman Islands.

datatec.name: Datatec
datatec.description: Datatec Limited is a South African international ICT solutions and services group operating in over 50 countries worldwide. The group offers integration and managed services, technology distribution, and financial services through three core divisions.

dasan-networks.name: DASAN Networks
dasan-networks.description: DASAN Networks is a South Korean company that develops and manufactures network equipment for fixed and mobile broadband services. Established in 1993 as DASAN Engineering Co., Ltd, it was listed on KOSDAQ in 2000 and renamed DASAN Networks Inc. in 2002.

dupont-fabros-technology-inc.name: DuPont Fabros Technology Inc.
dupont-fabros-technology-inc.description: DuPont Fabros Technology, Inc. was a real estate investment trust in the United States that invested in carrier-neutral data centers and provided colocation and peering services. The company was acquired by Digital Realty in 2017.

dollarama.name: Dollarama
dollarama.description: Dollarama Inc. is a Canadian dollar store retail chain headquartered in Mount Royal, Quebec. Established in 1992, it is Canada's largest retailer of items priced five dollars or less, operating over 1400 stores nationwide and owning other discount chains like The Reject Shop and Dollarcity.

dommo-energia.name: Dommo Energia
dommo-energia.description: Dommo Energia is a Brazilian publicly listed oil and gas company formerly known as OGX Petróleo e Gás Participações S.A. Before filing for bankruptcy in 2013, OGX was Brazil's second-largest oil company by market value after Petrobras.

dentsu-international.name: Dentsu International
dentsu-international.description: Dentsu International is a multinational media and digital marketing communications company headquartered in London, United Kingdom. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of the Japanese advertising and public relations firm Dentsu. The company offers services including communications strategy, media planning, sports marketing, and content creation.

d-box-technologies.name: D-Box Technologies
d-box-technologies.description: D-BOX Technologies Inc. is a Canadian haptic motion technology company based in Longueuil, Quebec. It designs and manufactures motion and haptic systems for entertainment, simulation, and training industries, with its seats installed in over 700 movie screens across 40 countries as of 2019.

delia-s.name: DELiA*s
delia-s.description: Delia's, Inc. was a lifestyle brand of apparel and accessories primarily targeting girls and young women in the United States. It focused on fashion products for a youthful demographic.

dfs.name: DFS
dfs.description: DFS Furniture plc, trading as dfs, is a furniture retailer operating in the United Kingdom and Ireland. It specializes in sofas and soft furnishings and is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

dof-group.name: DOF Group
dof-group.description: DOF ASA was the parent company of the DOF Group, a Norwegian supply shipping company. After bankruptcy proceedings in 2023, a new parent company DOF Group ASA was established, continuing global offshore services operations.

dairy-crest.name: Dairy Crest
dairy-crest.description: Saputo Dairy UK, also known as Dairy Crest Limited, is a British dairy products company created in 2019 after being acquired by Canadian company Saputo Inc. It was originally formed in 1981 as a spin-off of the Milk Marketing Board and owns brands like Cathedral City and Country Life.

dart-group.name: Dart Group
dart-group.description: Jet2 plc is a British multinational airline company based near Leeds, Yorkshire. It owns the low-cost airline Jet2.com and the package holiday company Jet2holidays.

dechra-pharmaceuticals.name: Dechra Pharmaceuticals
dechra-pharmaceuticals.description: Dechra is a company involved in the development and marketing of veterinary products based in Boston, Massachusetts. It was listed on the London Stock Exchange until it was acquired by EQT AB in January 2024.

delcath-systems-inc.name: Delcath Systems, Inc.
delcath-systems-inc.description: Delcath Systems, Inc. is a specialty pharmaceutical and medical device company based in Queensbury, New York. It develops percutaneous perfusion technologies for targeted administration of high-dose chemotherapeutic agents, with its Percutaneous Hepatic Perfusion system undergoing Phase II and III trials for liver tumors.

denison-mines.name: Denison Mines
denison-mines.description: Denison Mines Corp. is a Canadian company specializing in uranium exploration, development, and production. Founded by Stephen B. Roman, it is known for uranium mining in Blind River and Elliot Lake. The company has also diversified into coal, potash, and other projects.

detour-gold.name: Detour Gold
detour-gold.description: Detour Gold Corporation was a Canadian gold mining company that operated the Detour Lake Mine in northeastern Ontario from 2006 to 2020. The mine began production in 2013 and was acquired by Kirkland Lake Gold in 2020. It used open pit mining with cyanidation and carbon in pulp processing.

diamond-bank.name: Diamond Bank
diamond-bank.description: Diamond Bank Plc. was a Nigerian multinational financial service provider. It was acquired by Access Bank in December 2018 and fully merged with Access Bank on April 1, 2019, with the combined entity retaining the Access Bank name and adopting a logo inspired by Diamond Bank.

diamond-resorts.name: Diamond Resorts
diamond-resorts.description: Diamond Resorts is a timeshare and vacation ownership company based in the United States. It became a wholly owned subsidiary of Hilton Grand Vacations in 2021, with most resorts rebranded as Hilton Vacation Club properties while retaining the Diamond Resorts brand for some locations.

digital-river.name: Digital River
digital-river.description: Digital River, Inc. was a privately held company headquartered in Minnetonka, Minnesota, providing global e-commerce, payments, and marketing services. In 2013, it processed over US$30 billion in online transactions. The company filed for Chapter 7 bankruptcy in May 2025.

dignity-plc.name: Dignity plc
dignity-plc.description: Dignity Group is a funeral-related service provider based in the United Kingdom.

diploma-plc.name: Diploma plc
diploma-plc.description: Diploma plc is a British business supplying specialised technical products and services, based in London, England. It is a constituent of the FTSE 100 Index.

direct-line-group.name: Direct Line Group
direct-line-group.description: Direct Line Insurance Group Ltd. is a British insurance company based in Bromley, England. It was formed in 2012 after being divested from The Royal Bank of Scotland Group's insurance division. The company owns several insurance subsidiaries, including Direct Line, Churchill Insurance, Darwin, and Green Flag, a roadside assistance provider.

discovery-air.name: Discovery Air
discovery-air.description: Discovery Air was a specialized aviation company founded in 2004 that operated primarily in Canada. It focused on providing aviation services within the Canadian market.

domino-s-pizza-group-plc.name: Domino's Pizza Group plc
domino-s-pizza-group-plc.description: Domino's Pizza Group plc is a United Kingdom-based master franchise of the international fast food pizza delivery chain Domino's. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index. The company operates primarily in the food service industry.

domino-printing-sciences.name: Domino Printing Sciences
domino-printing-sciences.description: Domino Printing Sciences PLC is a British company that develops industrial and commercial printing technologies including inkjet, thermal transfer, and laser printing products. It was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by Brother Industries in 2015.

domstein.name: Domstein
domstein.description: Domstein is a Norwegian fishing company headquartered in Måløy. The company is controlled by Rolf Domstein and operates within the fishery industry.

db-insurance.name: DB Insurance
db-insurance.description: DB Insurance Co, Ltd. is a non-life insurance company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. It operates within the insurance industry providing various non-life insurance products.

dover-downs.name: Dover Downs
dover-downs.description: Bally's Dover Casino Resort, formerly Dover Downs, is a hotel, casino, and racetrack complex located in Dover, Delaware. It features a harness horse racing track and is surrounded by Dover Motor Speedway, a NASCAR motor racing circuit. The complex is owned by Gaming and Leisure Properties and operated by Bally's Corporation.

dresser-rand-group.name: Dresser-Rand Group
dresser-rand-group.description: Dresser-Rand is an American engineering and manufacturing company owned by Siemens Energy. It designs, manufactures, and services equipment used in petroleum and natural gas extraction. The company was formed in 1986 as a joint venture between Dresser Industries and Ingersoll Rand.

dundee-corporation.name: Dundee Corporation
dundee-corporation.description: Dundee Corporation is a public Canadian independent holding company based in Toronto, Ontario. It has holdings in wealth management, real estate, and resources. The company was founded in 1991 by Ned Goodman.

dunelm-group.name: Dunelm Group
dunelm-group.description: Dunelm Group plc, trading as Dunelm, is a British home furnishings retailer operating in Great Britain, Ireland, and Jersey. It is one of the largest homeware retailers in the UK with headquarters in Syston, England. The company was formerly known as Dunelm Mill until 2013.

dangote-group.name: Dangote Group
dangote-group.description: The Dangote Group is a Nigerian multinational industrial conglomerate founded by Aliko Dangote. It is the largest conglomerate in West Africa and one of the largest in Africa. The group employs over 30,000 people.

defence-industries-corporation-of-nigeri.name: Defence Industries Corporation of Nigeria
defence-industries-corporation-of-nigeri.description: Defence Industries Corporation of Nigeria (DICON) is a state-run defence corporation operated by the Nigerian Armed Forces. It produces defence equipment as well as civilian products. The company serves Nigeria's defence sector.

dana-air.name: Dana Air
dana-air.description: Dana Air was a Nigerian airline headquartered in Ikeja, Lagos State. It was based at Murtala Muhammed International Airport in Lagos. The airline operated in the Nigerian aviation sector.

dornier-aviation-nigeria.name: Dornier Aviation Nigeria
dornier-aviation-nigeria.description: Dornier Aviation Nigeria is an airline based in Kaduna, Nigeria. It operates Dornier aircraft on a charter basis and provides services including agricultural flying, aerial photography, and emergency medical evacuation. Its main base is Old Kaduna Airport, and it participated in the 2015 Hajj airlift financed by Nigerian businessman Babangida Inuwa.

dfcu-group.name: DFCU Group
dfcu-group.description: The Development Finance Company of Uganda Group, or DFCU Group, operates in both the financial and real estate sectors in Uganda. It is a notable company within Uganda's financial services industry.

denel.name: Denel
denel.description: Denel SOC Ltd is a South African state-owned aerospace and military technology conglomerate established in 1992. It is headquartered in Centurion, Gauteng. Denel operates within the aerospace and military technology sectors in South Africa.

dulce-cafe.name: Dulce Café
dulce-cafe.description: Dulce Café is a coffee shop and restaurant chain operating in South Africa. It originated in Port Elizabeth as a small ice cream shop in 1980 and has expanded to 53 stores across the country.

domestic-airlines.name: Domestic Airlines
domestic-airlines.description: Domestic Airlines, formerly Tassili Airlines, is an Algerian passenger airline based in Algiers. After a strategic restructuring in 2025, it operates as a wholly owned subsidiary of Air Algérie.

d-onofrio.name: D'Onofrio
d-onofrio.description: D'Onofrio is a Peruvian brand specializing in confectionery products, founded in 1897 by Pietro D'Onofrio. It is currently owned by Nestlé Perú and sells its products within Peru to a wide market of all ages.

digitel.name: Digitel
digitel.description: Digitel is a Venezuelan mobile phone company known for being the first to deploy a GSM network and establish per second charging. As of early 2007, it had over 3 million subscribers and ranks third behind Movilnet and Movistar in the country.

de-surinaamsche-bank.name: De Surinaamsche Bank
de-surinaamsche-bank.description: De Surinaamsche Bank is the largest bank in Suriname, providing retail banking products such as transaction accounts, loans, mortgages, and credit and debit cards. It also offers business loans. The bank plays a key role in Suriname's financial industry.

dhl-ecuador.name: DHL Ecuador
dhl-ecuador.description: DHL Ecuador (TransAm) Ltda. was a cargo airline based in Guayaquil, Ecuador, established in 1991. It was wholly owned by Deutsche Post and served the DHL logistics network in Ecuador. The airline suspended operations on July 14, 2025, and was replaced by DHL Aero Expreso.

davivienda.name: Davivienda
davivienda.description: Davivienda is a Colombian bank founded in 1972 that serves individuals, companies, and the rural sector. It is part of Grupo Bolivar and ranks as the second-largest bank in Colombia by assets and profits.

desnoes-geddes.name: Desnoes & Geddes
desnoes-geddes.description: Desnoes and Geddes Limited is a Jamaican brewer and beverage producer best known for Red Stripe lager. Founded in 1918, it started by producing soft drinks and distributing imported alcohol before opening the Surrey Brewery in Kingston.

dhl-de-guatemala.name: DHL de Guatemala
dhl-de-guatemala.description: DHL de Guatemala S.A. is a cargo airline based in Guatemala City, wholly owned by Deutsche Post. It operates services for the DHL-branded logistics network in Guatemala with its main base at La Aurora International Airport.

dar-el-shorouk.name: Dar El Shorouk
dar-el-shorouk.description: Dar El Shorouk is an Arabic publishing house based in Beirut and Cairo. It publishes books in politics, biographies, memoirs, history, philosophy, social sciences, religion, nationalist thought, art, and children's literature.

dhl-aero-expreso.name: DHL Aero Expreso
dhl-aero-expreso.description: DHL Aero Expreso S.A. is a cargo airline based in Panama City, Panama. Partly owned by the DHL Group, it operates DHL-branded parcel and express services in Central and South America. Its main base is Tocumen International Airport in Panama City.

diexim-expresso.name: Diexim Expresso
diexim-expresso.description: Diexim Expresso Aviaçao was an airline based in Luanda, Angola, operating scheduled, VIP, and charter flights within Angola and to Namibia. Its main base was Quatro de Fevereiro Airport, Luanda, and it was on the list of air carriers banned in the EU.

djibouti-telecom.name: Djibouti Telecom
djibouti-telecom.description: Djibouti Telecom is the government-run telecommunications monopoly in Djibouti. It provides landline, mobile, and internet services, including 3G and 4G+ services. The company is headquartered in the national capital of Djibouti.

daallo-airlines.name: Daallo Airlines
daallo-airlines.description: Daallo Airlines is a Somali-owned airline based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It operates scheduled flights in the Horn of Africa and the Middle East. The airline is banned from flying in the European Union.

djibouti-air.name: Djibouti Air
djibouti-air.description: Djibouti Air was an airline based in Djibouti that operated between 2011 and 2012. Its logo featured the Djibouti spurfowl. The airline is no longer active.
